non_acceptance_attempts.label: feature-direct
non_acceptance_attempts.reason: Connected Keychron keyboard system-control endpoint was exposed as a gamepad and opened the system wheel. A diagnostic repeat passed 49/49 unchanged. Final repeat excluded that hardware endpoint with SDL_GAMECONTROLLER_IGNORE_DEVICES=0x3434/0x0280 and passed 49/49 with no connected gamepads. Injected keyboard/mouse/gamepad events still run.

non_acceptance_attempts.label: android-background
non_acceptance_attempts.reason: Astral fixture was initially supplied with base-game data and was refused. Corrected the private runner campaign selection; real Home/return and autosave then passed 12/12. Both attempts restored the profile.

non_acceptance_attempts.label: early menu screenshots
non_acceptance_attempts.reason: Fixture reopened dialogs before the closed frame had been presented, recapturing old dialog artwork. Added presentation waits to the fixture; final full menu checks and visual inspection passed. Game sources did not change.

limits: Windows and macOS are cross-built and archive-inspected; no target-OS execution. macOS uses the stock universal runtime, is unsigned and not notarized.
Linux rendered UI checks use Compatibility; water checks use Forward+. Android rendered checks use Compatibility on Retroid/Adreno 650.
Control events are injected; no physical gamepad acceptance or new performance benchmark.
No full campaign-route or multi-machine acceptance.
Legacy converter remains API 1 in this release; the six inspected complete legacy mods remain blocked. The real-asset probe is intentionally partial and its assets are not distributed.
